practice.name: Collins Hospital for Animals
practice.tagline: Celebrating over 100 years caring for pets in Washington, DC.
practice.description: Collins Hospital for Animals provides high quality veterinary medicine, surgery, dentistry, diagnostics, boarding, daycare, and exotic pet care by appointment in Washington, DC.

team.name: Dr. Lynne D. Cabaniss
team.bio: Fourth owner of Collins Hospital for Animals after purchasing the practice in 1987. Her interests include exotic pet medicine, feline medicine and surgery, and cardiology.

team.name: Dr. Abby Littleton
team.bio: Georgetown University and University of Pennsylvania School of Veterinary Medicine graduate with interests including cardiology, neurology, reproduction, dentistry, and exotics.

team.name: Dr. Kristen Fischer
team.bio: Washington, DC veterinarian and current owner/operator as of January 2026, with interests in internal medicine, dermatology, and long-term family relationships.
